title: Onboarding funnel metrics — baseline + targets (v1) — 2026-01
content:
Sheet-like working doc. Numbers below are baseline for Hosted API, self-serve signups only.
Owner: Mei Lin (Analytics). Last updated: 2026-01-28.

========================
TAB: 0 — NOTES / DEFINITIONS
========================
Date range used for baseline: 2025-12-15 → 2026-01-14 (rolling 31 days)
Population: new orgs created via self-serve signup (excludes sales-provisioned enterprise orgs; excludes Dedicated/Private).
Unit of analysis: org_id (primary), with supporting views at project_id.

Funnel step definitions (baseline v0; will be aligned to Event Schema v1 once final):
1) Signup (ORG_CREATED)
   - Timestamp: org.created_at
2) API key created (API_KEY_CREATED)
   - Count orgs with ≥1 key created within 7 days of signup
   - Note: today we can only reliably infer “key created” from control-plane audit log; Console event coverage is incomplete.
3) First successful API response (FIRST_SUCCESS)
   - Org has ≥1 2xx response from inference gateway on Hosted API (chat/completions/embeddings)
   - Measured per project_id and rolled up to org
   - Excludes health checks and internal probes
4) First streaming session (FIRST_STREAM)
   - Org has ≥1 successful streaming response (SSE) that emits ≥1 token chunk
   - Important: baseline capture is partial; some SDKs don’t emit explicit streaming telemetry yet.
5) Repeat usage (REPEAT_7D)
   - Org has activity on ≥2 distinct days in the 7 days after FIRST_SUCCESS
   - “Activity” = ≥1 successful request day (2xx)
   - Alternate metric (not used for headline): ≥5,000 output tokens in 7 days after FIRST_SUCCESS
6) “Prod intent” proxy (PROD_KEY)
   - Org creates a key labeled “prod” OR toggles “production mode” (future)
   - Baseline is approximate; “prod vs test” UX not shipped yet → label is inferred from key name patterns (contains ‘prod’, ‘production’) and key permissions.

Time-to-first-success (TTFS) definition:
- TTFS = time from Signup (ORG_CREATED) to FIRST_SUCCESS.
- Reported as median/p90 among orgs that reached FIRST_SUCCESS within 7 days.

Known caveats / data quality notes:
- Some orgs onboard via direct API calls (curl) without using Console → steps like “Visited dashboard” aren’t measurable pre-checklist.
- FIRST_SUCCESS uses gateway logs; processing delay typically 2–7 minutes; during incident INT-3321 we saw 30–90 min delays in one region.
- “API key created” counts may be slightly underreported due to audit-log ingestion delays (rare, but seen during deploy windows).

Planned alignment (Phase 1 checklist work):
- Replace inferred steps with explicit telemetry events from Console/backend (per onboarding-telemetry-event-schema-v1).
- Ensure consistent identity: org_id + project_id + user_id (where available), with dedupe keys.


====================================
TAB: 1 — HEADLINE FUNNEL (BASELINE)
====================================
All new org signups in range (N=12,480)

Funnel (org-level)
| Step | Orgs | % of signups | Drop from prior step |
|------|------|--------------|----------------------|
| Signup (ORG_CREATED) | 12,480 | 100.0% | — |
| API key created within 7d | 7,110 | 57.0% | -43.0% |
| First successful API response within 7d | 4,520 | 36.2% | -20.8% (from key step) |
| First streaming session within 7d | 1,640 | 13.1% | -23.1% (from first success) |
| Repeat usage (≥2 active days in 7d after first success) | 1,950 | 15.6% | -56.9% (from first success) |
| Prod intent proxy (prod-like key name/perm) within 14d | 820 | 6.6% | -58.0% (from repeat usage) |

Notes:
- Repeat usage % is relative to signups (not only those who hit FIRST_SUCCESS). Among orgs that hit FIRST_SUCCESS, 43.1% repeat within 7 days.
- FIRST_STREAM is not a required step today, but it is a strong predictor of repeat usage (see Tab 4).


================================================
TAB: 2 — TIME-TO-STEP (TTFS + LATENCIES)
================================================
Distributions are among orgs that reached each step within the window specified.

Time from Signup → API key created (within 7d)
| Metric | Time |
|--------|------|
| p50 | 7 min |
| p75 | 41 min |
| p90 | 3 hr 12 min |
| p95 | 9 hr 05 min |

Time from API key created → First successful API response (within 7d)
| Metric | Time |
|--------|------|
| p50 | 14 min |
| p75 | 1 hr 06 min |
| p90 | 10 hr 44 min |
| p95 | 1 day 18 hr |

TTFS: Signup → First successful API response (within 7d)
| Metric | Time |
|--------|------|
| p50 | 28 min |
| p75 | 2 hr 11 min |
| p90 | 18 hr 37 min |
| p95 | 3 days 04 hr |

Time from First success → Repeat usage (repeat = ≥2 active days in next 7d)
| Metric | Time |
|--------|------|
| p50 | 3.2 days |
| p75 | 4.8 days |
| p90 | 6.4 days |

Time from First success → First streaming session (among those who streamed)
| Metric | Time |
|--------|------|
| p50 | 40 min |
| p75 | 6.1 hr |
| p90 | 2.2 days |

Interpretation / notes:
- TTFS median (28 min) is “not terrible” but p90 is high (18+ hours). Long tail correlates with auth issues + rate limit confusion + streaming disconnect retries.
- The biggest drop is Signup → Key (43%). Some of this is natural exploration, but support tickets indicate confusion about where to create keys and which key to use (test vs prod) (ref: SUP-9244).


=============================================
TAB: 3 — COHORT BREAKDOWNS (CONVERSION RATES)
=============================================
A) By SDK/Client (inferred from User-Agent where possible; unknown bucket is large)
| Client bucket | Share of orgs w/ FIRST_SUCCESS | Repeat_7D rate among FIRST_SUCCESS | TTFS p50 |
|--------------|---------------------------------|------------------------------------|---------|
| Python SDK | 34% | 47% | 24 min |
| TypeScript SDK | 22% | 45% | 26 min |
| Go SDK | 6% | 44% | 31 min |
| curl / raw HTTP | 18% | 38% | 19 min |
| Unknown / other | 20% | 40% | 36 min |

Notes:
- curl/raw HTTP hits FIRST_SUCCESS quickly but repeats less often; hypothesis: quick test call then churn due to missing production guidance.
- “Unknown/other” likely includes older SDKs + community clients; better UA standardization recommended.

B) By region (based on first successful request region)
| Region | Signups | FIRST_SUCCESS % of signups | Repeat_7D % of FIRST_SUCCESS | TTFS p50 |
|--------|---------|----------------------------|------------------------------|----------|
| North America | 7,120 | 38.9% | 44% | 24 min |
| Europe | 3,410 | 34.7% | 43% | 31 min |
| APAC | 1,950 | 30.5% | 39% | 41 min |

Notes:
- APAC TTFS is slower; could be docs latency, network, or higher share of users starting with streaming (where we see more disconnect issues).

C) By acquisition source (best-effort attribution from UTM on signup; incomplete)
| Source | Signups | Key created % | FIRST_SUCCESS % | Repeat_7D % (of FIRST_SUCCESS) |
|--------|---------|--------------|----------------|--------------------------------|
| Docs (utm_source=docs) | 2,840 | 63% | 41% | 46% |
| GitHub (utm_source=github) | 1,960 | 59% | 39% | 42% |
| Community/blog (utm_source=blog) | 1,120 | 52% | 32% | 41% |
| Paid search | 860 | 44% | 24% | 36% |
| Unknown / none | 5,700 | 55% | 35% | 43% |

Notes:
- Attribution is noisy; once checklist deep-links ship, we should standardize UTM conventions (see DES-115).


=================================================
TAB: 4 — PREDICTORS / CORRELATIONS (QUICK CUTS)
=================================================
(Not causal. Intended to help prioritize checklist steps.)

Streaming usage vs repeat usage (among orgs with FIRST_SUCCESS)
| Segment | Orgs | Repeat_7D rate |
|---------|------|----------------|
| Had FIRST_STREAM within 7d | 1,640 | 58% |
| No streaming within 7d | 2,880 | 34% |

Observability touch vs repeat usage (proxy: visited usage dashboard; partial instrumentation)
| Segment | Orgs | Repeat_7D rate |
|---------|------|----------------|
| Visited usage dashboard within 3d of FIRST_SUCCESS | 620 | 61% |
| Did not visit within 3d | 3,900 | 40% |

Error-heavy early experience vs repeat usage (based on gateway logs in first 30 min after key creation)
| Segment | Orgs | Repeat_7D rate |
|---------|------|----------------|
| ≥3 errors (401/429/5xx/timeouts) in first 30 min | 980 | 27% |
| <3 errors in first 30 min | 3,540 | 47% |

Notes / implications:
- Getting users to a stable streaming example (with retries/timeouts) looks high leverage, but we must reduce streaming disconnect friction (SUP-9210).
- Early error experiences strongly correlate with churn; checklist should front-load “common failures” and point to fixes.


=============================================
TAB: 5 — TOP FAILURE MODES (EARLY ONBOARDING)
=============================================
From support tags + gateway error distribution (first 24h after signup). Counts are approximate; support is undercounted relative to total.

Gateway errors (share of non-2xx responses in first 24h)
| Error category | Approx share | Notes |
|----------------|--------------|------|
| 401 Unauthorized | 22% | wrong key/env, key not added, using org key in project context; aligns with SUP-9244 |
| 429 Rate limited | 19% | bursts from retries without backoff; unclear quotas; aligns with SUP-9182 |
| 408/timeout | 14% | default client timeouts too low for longer outputs; varies by SDK |
| Streaming disconnect | 9% | network + missing retry/resume guidance; aligns with SUP-9210 |
| 400 validation errors | 11% | schema mismatch; confusion about message formatting / tool calling |
| 5xx | 6% | actual platform errors; separate from onboarding but impacts perceived reliability |
| Other | 19% | mixed |

Support ticket themes (last 60 days; sample)
- “I keep getting 401” → user copied test key into prod service / wrong header format
- “I got rate limited instantly” → user ran example loop or retries without jitter/backoff
- “Streaming cuts off / hangs” → user not handling SSE reconnect; proxies/load balancers closing idle connections


====================================
TAB: 6 — TARGETS (PHASE 1 CHECKLIST)
====================================
Targets are directional for Phase 1 (Hosted API, self-serve) and assume we ship:
- In-console guided checklist w/ deep links + some auto-validation
- SDK snippet parity (Python/TS/Go) for auth, retries, streaming
- Troubleshooting doc surfaced at key steps

Target measurement window: 30 days post-GA, evaluated on new org cohorts only.

A) Funnel conversion targets (org-level)
| Metric | Baseline | Target (Phase 1) | Notes |
|--------|----------|------------------|------|
| Key created within 7d (% of signups) | 57% | 65% | Reduce “where do I get a key?” friction + clearer key UX |
| FIRST_SUCCESS within 7d (% of signups) | 36% | 45% | More reliable quickstarts + error handling guidance |
| Repeat_7D among FIRST_SUCCESS | 43% | 50% | Encourage dashboard usage + streaming + prod checklist |
| Prod intent proxy within 14d (% of signups) | 6.6% | 10% | New prod/test key flow + production checklist definition |

B) TTFS targets
| Metric | Baseline | Target |
|--------|----------|--------|
| TTFS p50 (Signup → FIRST_SUCCESS) | 28 min | 20 min |
| TTFS p90 | 18 hr 37 min | 10 hr |

C) Error reduction targets (first 24h after signup)
| Error type | Baseline share of non-2xx | Target | Primary lever |
|------------|---------------------------|--------|--------------|
| 401 | 22% | 15% | prod/test key clarity + copy + examples |
| 429 | 19% | 14% | quota education step + retry defaults |
| timeouts | 14% | 10% | standardized timeouts in SDK snippets |
| streaming disconnect | 9% | 7% | improved streaming examples + reconnection guidance |


====================================
TAB: 7 — OPEN QUESTIONS / TODO
====================================
TODO (Analytics)
- Confirm org cohort filtering rules w/ Product (exclude sales-provisioned orgs; exclude employees) (owner: Mei, Nikhil)
- Define canonical “repeat usage” metric for onboarding scorecard (active days vs token threshold vs API calls) (owner: Mei)
- Add breakdown by “Console first” vs “API first” onboarding path once we have stable Console event coverage (owner: Nadia)

TODO (Telemetry)
- Finalize event schema mapping: ORG_CREATED, API_KEY_CREATED, FIRST_SUCCESS, FIRST_STREAM, USAGE_DASHBOARD_VIEWED, PROD_KEY_CREATED, CHECKLIST_STEP_COMPLETED (owner: Nadia, Logan)
- Ensure dedupe keys for FIRST_SUCCESS and FIRST_STREAM to avoid double counts from retries (owner: Logan)

TODO (Product/DevEx)
- Confirm if streaming is a checklist-required step or optional “recommended” step; early data shows strong correlation with repeat (owner: Marissa, Monica)
- Decide where “retries/timeouts” appears: standalone checklist step vs part of “First production launch” group (ref: Slack thread-1738711109)

Questions
- What is the exact definition of “first production launch” for this scorecard? Candidate: (prod key created) AND (≥10k tokens in a 24h period) AND (usage dashboard visited OR alerts configured). Need signoff. (owner: Nikhil/Marissa)
- Do we want to optimize for faster FIRST_SUCCESS or better “success quality” (fewer errors) even if slightly slower? Current hypothesis: reducing early error loops increases repeat usage more than shaving minutes off p50.

Change log
- 2026-01-09: v1 baseline drafted from gateway logs + audit logs.
- 2026-01-16: added acquisition source + region breakdown; added predictor cuts.
- 2026-01-28: aligned targets with checklist PRD scope; added error-type reduction targets.
